description: Code, sample data, a neural-network model and a graphical interface support soft sensing of final-effluent biochemical oxygen demand. This resource is provided by mhasnai (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The short README does not establish plant coverage, training periods or validated forecasting performance. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
